title: go-19x19/1 state
description: pgx go_19x19 env v1. The history is the state; the server replays it and checks the other fields against it, which the schema cannot.

board.description: The 361 points, row * 19 + col, rank 1 first: 1 black, -1 white, 0 empty.

ko.description: The point the side to move may not play on, having just lost a ko there.

history.description: Every move since the empty board, as pgx actions: a point 0-360, or 361 for a pass.
